protocol: close at full command, settle, measure pad penetration and normal force, then raise the hand at a fixed rate and record height and grip
note: one object, one mass, one grip command: a fingerprint of the contact model, not a sweep

rows.caveat: Isaac reports joint forces rather than per-contact normals here, so the force column is a finger-joint magnitude and is NOT comparable in units to MuJoCo's contact normal. The lift and grip columns are comparable; the force column is not, and saying so is the point of writing it down.
